facts.fact: Shikiriza reports that Burundi's National Assembly adopted the access to public information bill unanimously on 10 September 2026 and that, as of 28 September 2026, the President had not yet promulgated it.
facts.system: Projet de loi sur l'accès à l'information publique

BDI.note: The document says nothing on rural internet programmes or use.
No named paper or group criticises a named policy, and no dated cut or punishment is stated; only general remarks on self-censorship.
